baseline_findings: T-SHIPPED (treatment): Shipped carrier + 5-example induction. Primary measurement arm. Zero false accepts on OUT, zero HTTP on OUT. Coverage 10/19 on declared IN items. Correctly measures the safety boundary of the induced single-observation-length support.

B-WIDENED-3 (strong comparator): Same carrier mechanism with support overridden to ^item\-[0-9]{3}$ (declared 3-digit grammar). Achieves false_accept_count=0 AND coverage=1.0 (19/19 IN accepted, 0/59 OUT accepted). Proves a safe, complete alternative exists on this bank. Not a hard gate but critical for claim ceiling: the over-conservatism is avoidable.

PC-UNSAFE-COARSE (positive control / detector sensitivity): Same carrier mechanism with support overridden to __COARSE__ (carrier's own coarse fallback sentinel accepting any non-empty string without whitespace or '/'). Must false-accept >= 1; observed 38. Non-vacuous detector confirmed. Uses no new code - __COARSE__ is the shipped _COARSE_SUPPORT constant.

NC-REJECT-ALL (null control): Empty registry. Must accept nothing and issue zero HTTP; observed 0/0. Anchors the measurement floor. If it accepted anything, the safety certificate's zero would be meaningless.

B-LITERAL-KERNEL (ablation / attribution): Pre-promotion literal kernel (git blob cfec9866...) loaded in hermetic temp package with same shipped models/registry/init. Must lack distill_parameterized; confirmed false. If it unexpectedly had the parameterized path, attribution of the positive to the installed carrier would break -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

PC-EXACT-REPLAY (positive control / execution-path integrity): After induction, re-resolve each of the 5 training ids; all 5 must be EXECUTABLE. Confirmed 5/5. Failure would indicate broken bind/registry -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

All arms share the identical carrier mechanism code path (src/spider/kernel.py); only the verification_rule support descriptor differs. This isolates the effect of the support predicate from other mechanism behavior. Carrier bytes pinned by sha256 + freeze-artifact hash + parent handoff identity.
claim_ceiling: The shipped carrier's conservative abstention boundary is SAFE on the frozen 78-item materially varied/out-of-grammar bank: M-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT == 0, M-SILENT-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT == 0, M-REFUSAL-ZERO-HTTP == 0. Zero out-of-grammar payloads bind EXECUTABLE; zero out-of-grammar HTTP requests issued. The boundary is over-conservative: M-COVERAGE = 10/19 (9 of 19 declared 3-digit ids refused: item-010, item-011, item-042, item-099, item-100, item-123, item-256, item-500, item-999). The strong comparator B-WIDENED-3 (support ^item\-[0-9]{3}$) achieves false_accept_count=0 AND coverage=1.0, demonstrating a safe complete alternative exists on this bank. This certifies the safety boundary for external consumption with a documented coverage caveat and a concrete remediation option. C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL and C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS in all branches; no claim advance or product promotion is authorized. The four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark remains externally gated on Runtime readiness (2) and Intel readiness (3).
